messages:
Maya Chen: Quick follow-up from the postmortem run: we're seeing a repeating cluster of authz issues across months -> (A) token validation flips after rolling deploys, (B) missing audit records during service-account rotations, and (C) recurring orphaned credentials showing up in the token-index. We need a concrete action handoff + short deadlines so these don't recur.

Eve Tran: +1. Can we pick a canonical log sample to bake into the smoke test and the alert rule?

Maya Chen: Putting one we pulled from the bundle:
```
ERROR authz validate_token: iss mismatch, token_kid=ks-11, jwk_fetch=504, req_id=inc-22f
```

Noah Becker: Observed timeline: failures spike 10-60s after deploy completion; key-service churn correlates. Also saw secure-log return 429 during a rotation which the rotation handler ignored.

Rhea Iyer: On audit loss: current rotation flow uses async log fire-and-forget to the sink. If the sink is rate-limited we lose the durable event. We should make the audit write part of the commit path (write-with-ack) and surface failures to on-call.

Omar Khan: Draft remediation slate (2-week sprint):
- Owner: Eve Tran  post-deploy token smokecheck + CI gating (due 2026-08-10)
- Owner: Rhea Iyer  rotation write-with-ack + retries + rollback on persistent failure (due 2026-08-12)
- Owner: Noah Becker  keystore client HA + startup jwk-prefetch + cache-invalidation hook (due 2026-08-08)
- Owner: Omar Khan  orphaned-creds sweeper + runbook + one-off backfill (due 2026-08-17)
- Owner: Maya Chen  authz trend dashboard + weekly digest alert (due 2026-08-05)
Please ack so I can populate the remediation tracker.

Eve Tran: ack. I'll implement a lightweight curl-based post-deploy check that validates a signed token from a canary replica. Will gate deploys in staging and add a non-blocking timer in prod to avoid false blocking.

Rhea Iyer: ack. I'll change rotation handler to perform secure-log write synchronously with exponential backoff up to N attempts, then fail/rollback and page on-call if still failing. I'll include an integration test that simulates sink 429/503.

Noah Becker: ack. Plan: add prefetch at startup, increase JWK TTL slightly, and add an invalidation event tied to rotations so services rotate keys atomically. Will run a staging chaos test to confirm.

Omar Khan: ack. I'll write the sweeper job, add playbook steps for manual remediation, and create a backfill job to ensure missing audit events are reconciled into the secure-log.

ops-bot: Task created: AUTHZ-8200 assigned to Eve Tran, due 2026-08-10

ops-bot: Task created: AUTHZ-8201 assigned to Rhea Iyer, due 2026-08-12

ops-bot: Task created: AUTHZ-8202 assigned to Noah Becker, due 2026-08-08

ops-bot: Task created: AUTHZ-8203 assigned to Omar Khan, due 2026-08-17

Maya Chen: Suggest we run a one-time smoke window after changes: pick three critical services, deploy the changes in staging + run rotation tests, then run a canary in prod with a 30-min monitoring window. I'll schedule a 30-min "authz pattern retro" recurring monthly to review metrics and stuck actions.

Eve Tran: I'll add a synthetic alert that fires if token-validation-failures > X in a 10-minute window post-deploy. We should keep threshold conservative to avoid noise.

Rhea Iyer: For audit sink, I'll add a short circuit-breaker with escalation and a dashboard panel showing write success rate over time.

Noah Becker: If any owner can't meet their ETA, please post here 48h beforehand with a reassignment or scope-reduction proposal.

Maya Chen: Thanks team. I'll create the tracker items and add links to the PRs and playbook here once they exist. Leaving the final checklist: smoke PRs, rotation tests, JWK prefetch rollout, sweeper job, dashboard + retro invite. :white_check_mark:
